t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The gnomes always appear in the same pair. Orange, green, red and blue take you to the bright forest always, the other colours take you to a duller forest. Aim to get as many mushrooms as possible and you should be able to work out which gnomes lead to which forest to obtain the most mushrooms.

vb_textbox.text: The main aim of the game is to gather as many mushrooms as possible.You are presented with a pair of mushrooms on each screen, the pairs are always orange and brown, green and pink, red and yellow and blue and purple. They may change position from left to right each time.There are two forests, one which is dark and dull and contains a yellow basket. The other forest is bright with a red basket. Gnomes orange, green, red and blue always lead to the bright forest with the red basket.Gnomes brown, pink, yellow and purple always lead to the full forest with the yellow basket.You might notice a pattern as to which forest leads to most mushrooms, remember, some forests don't contain any mushrooms!The gnomes may appear different in size, hat type and position (left and right), this does not affect the amount of mushrooms you can gather so please ignore it.Have fun and try to remember which gnomes lead to the most fruitful forest!
